units.source_text: 且说那个朦胧月夜的小姐，回想那晚间的迷离春梦，不胜悲叹，心中怀着无限思量。

en.t: Now the young lady of that misty moonlit night thought back on the blurred spring dream of that evening, sighed in deep sorrow, and carried endless reflections in her heart.

units.source_text: 她已许嫁皇太子，预定四月间入东宫成亲，为此更添忧恼。

en.t: She had already been promised in marriage to the Crown Prince and was scheduled to enter the Eastern Palace in the fourth month for the wedding, which only added to her distress.

units.source_text: 男的这边呢，并非全无办法探寻底细，但因尚未确定她是第几位女公子，又因与弘徽殿女御一向不睦，

en.t: As for the man, it was not as if he had no way at all to investigate the truth, but he still did not know which daughter she was, and he had long been on poor terms with the Kokiden Consort,

units.source_text: 贸然求婚，有失体面，为此不胜烦闷。

en.t: so to propose rashly would be improper and damaging to his dignity, and this left him deeply troubled.

units.source_text: 三月二十日过后，右大臣家举行赛箭会，招请众公卿及亲王参与赛箭，接着便是观赏藤花的宴会。

en.t: After the twentieth day of the third month, the Minister of the Right held an archery contest at his residence, inviting many courtiers and princes to take part, followed by a banquet for viewing the wisteria blossoms.

units.source_text: 其时樱花已经零落，但是尚有两株迟开的樱花树，

en.t: By then the cherry blossoms had already fallen, but there were still two late-blooming cherry trees,

units.source_text: 仿佛懂得古歌“山樱僻处无人见，着意留春独后开”[\[7\]](#part1337.html#m7)之趣，正开得非常茂盛。

en.t: as if they understood the spirit of the old poem, "Mountain cherries bloom unseen in lonely places, lingering with spring and opening late on purpose"[\[7\]](#part1337.html#m7), and they were now in exceptionally full bloom.

units.source_text: 最近新建的一所殿堂，为了准备弘徽殿女御所生的公主的着裳仪式[\[8\]](#part1337.html#m8)，装饰得十分华丽。

en.t: A recently built hall had been richly decorated in preparation for the coming-of-age robe ceremony[\[8\]](#part1337.html#m8) of the princess born to the Kokiden Consort.

units.source_text: 右大臣家讲究排场，一切设备都很新颖时髦。

en.t: The Minister of the Right's household valued splendor, and all the furnishings and arrangements were fresh and stylish.

units.source_text: 今日赛箭赏花，右大臣前天在宫中遇见源氏公子时，已曾当面邀请他参加。

en.t: For today's archery contest and flower viewing, the Minister of the Right had already invited Prince Genji in person when he met him at court the day before yesterday.

units.source_text: 但深恐公子不到，致使盛会减色，为此再派儿子少将前来迎接，并赠诗道：

en.t: But fearing greatly that the prince might not come and that the splendid gathering would lose its luster, he sent his son, the Lesser Captain, to escort him once more, and included a poem saying:
